entries.assertion: the six core skills are all covered by one thickening governance surface
each core skill exposes Inputs Contract, Decision Protocol, Anti-Inertia Notes, Learning Notes, and Backstop CLI
the thickened skill surface can be consumed by the host without relying on hidden code-only fallback
thickened skill surfaces do not become freeform frozen-truth write surfaces
Beacon formally treats `beacon ask` as an existing public route surface rather than a proposed future command
`beacon ask` continues to default to plan-only mode
`ask --execute` can only route into existing legal Beacon surfaces and cannot bypass implement, qa, or gate
`ask` cannot directly write frozen truth, gate verdict, or release state
`ask` is classified as natural-language entry, route preview, and controlled execution surface
`brainstorm` is classified as read-only convergence, contradiction check, and route suggestion surface
frozen-truth change requests route to the change loop instead of remaining in ask or brainstorm
ask, brainstorm, and change are not presented as replacements for the seven-stage main lifecycle
learning disclosure reuses the existing typed learning contract kernel rather than inventing a parallel system
learning hints can be disclosed in feature, host, runner, then domain order
learning hints influence routing or explanation but cannot define truth, gate verdict, or release-ready
stale or superseded learning notes downgrade cleanly instead of continuing to steer decisions as fresh evidence
when diagram-truth complexity is present, requirement generation cannot fall back to shallow template fill
prd, user-story, and test-case generation explicitly reason about states, transitions, exceptional paths, and invariants
state-axis information is detected and reused when the problem exposes a stable state ladder
requirement outputs remain consistent with existing diagram truth artifacts
semantic trace is treated as a shared input for requirement generation and validation
official state, action, module, and page terms are preferred over ad hoc wording
semantic trace can validate wording but does not become a second truth root
requirement wording drift against semantic trace is surfaced and reduced
the first-stage modeling upgrade explicitly reuses diagram truth and semantic dictionary before adding new structures
any addition of events, invariants, or entities remains minimal and justified by gaps in existing modeling
the feature does not require a full new five-folder business-model truth structure as an entry condition
governance closes around existing modeling before heavier structural expansion is allowed
Python responsibility converges on fact read, schema validation, contract write, and gate verdict write
explanatory and decision-protocol content is promoted into skill surfaces instead of remaining hidden in Python fallback
Python still enforces fail-closed behavior after explanation logic is migrated upward
the feature does not drift into a language-migration objective
qa, implement, prd, and release all enter the same slimming-governance scope
each target module separates fact-write logic from explanation-judgment logic
migration prioritizes explanation and judgment logic before touching guardrail write paths
all four modules share one slimming-governance standard rather than diverging into local heuristics
no decision cutover occurs before dual-read comparison is available
blocked reason, downgrade path, fallback path, and gate verdict consistency are all checked during dual-read
cutover remains blocked when dual-read consistency is insufficient
a compatibility window preserves legacy fallback even after primary cutover
core skills no longer present mixed v1.3.9, v1.3.12, and v1.4.0 storytelling drift
operator-rule text matches the current runtime and docs reality
runtime, docs, and host-native version lines are internally consistent
version-surface alignment occurs before or alongside thickening rather than after it
help, status, doctor, and ask can explain why a route is recommended
human-facing recommendation can indicate whether learning hints were used
the system can clearly explain when brainstorm is appropriate and when change is mandatory
default support output prioritizes action rationale over raw command dumping
the feature formally treats prototype as a conditionally triggered stage before implement because a real UX/UI handoff surface exists
prototype scope covers decision-surface route presentation for core skills and ask/brainstorm/change
prototype handoff requires state visibility, navigation contract, and interaction contract
the feature cannot be described as implement-ready before prototype freeze artifacts exist
requirement gate still blocks when frozen human requirement truth is incomplete
missing machine-side requirement projections no longer act as default hard gate blockers
feature-level implement/qa gate does not inherit unrelated sibling feature drift from the same version line
baseline hash / revision receipt drift remains a fail-closed blocker even after machine projection slimming
happy coverage remains traceable to requirement truth
negative coverage remains traceable to requirement truth
boundary coverage remains traceable to requirement truth
exception coverage remains traceable to requirement truth
recovery coverage remains traceable to requirement truth
compatibility coverage remains traceable to requirement truth
permission coverage remains traceable to requirement truth
stale-data-or-drift coverage remains traceable to requirement truth
downgrade-or-fallback coverage remains traceable to requirement truth
